Problem Statement:
Jack is playing with an array A of N numbers. Each number in the array is either 0 or 1 Replacing a 0 with 1 costs X rupees. Replacing a 1 with 0 costs Y rupees. Jack is given Q queries of the form L R where he wants to know what is the minimum cost to make the subarray A[L] , A[L+1] , A[L+2] .... A[R] such that all elements are 0 or all elements are 1. Help him solve this problem. 
Input Description:
The first line contains a single integer N representing the size of the array The second line contains N integers each of which is 0 or 1 The third line contains a single integer Q - the number of questions The next Q lines consist of a four integers L R X Y each representing the query for range L,R and the cost of replacement for that query 
Output Description:
The output must consist of Q lines each of which contains a single integer-the answer to the corresponding query. 
Explanation:
Since the cost of replacing a 1 with a 0 is 0 rupees , we can replace all 1s with 0s free of cost. On the other hand replacing the 0 with 1 costs 10 rupees so the total cost is 0
